decisions.reason: Even with weak visibility after 2019, management would still hesitate to withdraw this former flagship because of its high sunk investment and public tie to the firm's sustainability-led direction, though that commitment is starting to erode.

As a multi-model foldable container line in the firm's core reusable-packaging business, it still benefits from substantial prior investment and from the argument that customer adoption and line optimization can take several years.

Because this crate line was less visibly committed than the others and has shown no later website presence, management can more easily justify ending it and redirecting resources after giving it several years to pay off.

Although the firm made a visible commitment through a dedicated product-line presentation, its somewhat less central fit and lack of visible follow-through make withdrawal increasingly defensible in 2022.
